description: This Java class defines the FtpServices class responsible for providing FTP transfer services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating FTP clients based on server type, and a main service method to send content to an FTP server, handling connection setup, data streaming, optional ZIP compression, re-verification, and error handling.

classes.name: FtpServices
classes.description: Provides FTP transfer services, including creating FTP clients based on server type and sending content files via FTP with optional ZIP compression and transfer verification.

methods.name: createFtpClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate FtpClientInterface implementation based on the specified server type (ftp, ftps, sftp). Throws GeneralException for unimplemented or unsupported types.

methods.name: sendContentToFtp
methods.description: Main service method that retrieves FTP configuration, establishes connection, streams content to the remote server, optionally compresses it into a ZIP, and verifies transfer success if configured to do so. Handles errors and resource cleanup.
